behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert insertion of inner boundaries, unmapped/remapped spans and exact mapped diagnostic coordinates.
Assert outer-end precedence, one-hop behavior, missing line/anchor, snapshots and malformed map ordering.
docDelivery: Document anchor span/coordinate semantics and boundary insertion.
Explain one-hop source lookup, unmapped diagnostics, validation and snapshot behavior.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Piecewise same-line mapping composition with split spans, unmapped intervals, one-hop semantics and diagnostic consumer snapshot.
independence: Compose generated-to-intermediate and intermediate-to-source mapping anchors with unmapped segments and diagnostic consumers.
